mainEntity.name: Can exterior water damage affect my home's foundation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, persistent exterior water damage can absolutely affect your home's foundation. Water continuously pooling around the foundation can lead to soil erosion, hydrostatic pressure against foundation walls, and eventual cracking or shifting. This is particularly critical in areas with expansive soils. A First-Party Insight: Our initial assessment always includes checking for signs of water directing towards the foundation, as addressing proper drainage is key to preventing long-term structural issues that extend beyond the immediate exterior damage.
